description: This file contains a PHP trait 'EndpointRegionHelperTrait' within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for Amazon S3. The trait provides helper methods for managing endpoint regions, validating regions, and handling region-specific logic related to AWS services.

methods.name: getPartitionSuffix
methods.description: Returns the DNS suffix for a given AWS ARN and partition endpoint provider.

methods.name: getSigningRegion
methods.description: Determines the signing region for a given region and service, using partition data.

methods.name: isMatchingSigningRegion
methods.description: Checks whether the ARN's region matches the client's region or the region used for signing, considering pseudo-regions.

methods.name: validateFipsConfigurations
methods.description: Validates whether FIPS configurations are compatible with the specified ARN and region.

methods.name: validateMatchingRegion
methods.description: Validates whether the ARN's region matches the client's region or the signing region.
